subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin/context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main has partial bootstrap and compaction-extension work, but choosing a generic relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core requires architecture intent rather than a one-shot bug fix.

options.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
options.body: Use this issue as an umbrella only until maintainers confirm focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction ownership.

options.title: Keep As Architecture Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as a parent discussion and block automated repair until one track is prioritized.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after bootstrap and compaction are covered by narrower open items and observation extraction is confirmed outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
recommendation.body: Use this issue as an umbrella only until maintainers confirm focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the issue's maintainer-style review and is the clearest product-routing candidate in the discussion history.
